statements.quote: L4.13 Each compute tray shall convert the 54 VDC in-rack bus, which varies between 40 VDC and 60 VDC, to a 12 VDC intermediate bus for the tray's boards. The converter shall deliver at least 1,500 W of continuous output power per tray.
statements.text: Each compute tray shall convert the 54 VDC in-rack bus (40-60 VDC range) to a 12 VDC intermediate bus, delivering at least 1,500 W continuous output power per tray.

statements.quote: L4.14 The compute tray converters shall report telemetry over PMBus and shall have a typical efficiency of at least 97% at full load.
statements.text: The compute tray converters shall report telemetry over PMBus and have a typical efficiency of at least 97% at full load.

statements.quote: L4.15 Each compute tray converter shall fit a board area of at most 60 mm by 40 mm, with a height of at most 15 mm.
statements.text: Each compute tray converter shall fit a board area of at most 60 mm by 40 mm, with a height of at most 15 mm.
